page.overview:
Who is Ba'Seet?

Ba'Seet was an arms dealer on planet Wroona. smuggler Jorj Car'das accepted to go to Wroona to save a family taken hostage by the alien warlord Nuso Esva after Galactic Empire Senior Captain Thrawn asked him to do so. As Car'das believed Esva had obtained the thermal detonators he used to sabotage the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Chimaera, the smuggler decided to start his search for the family with Ba'Seet.
